title: Build prompt constructor for loop runner
description: Create a function that assembles the full prompt sent to the AI backend for each loop iteration. Combines PROMPT.md instructions, PRD content, and the current task details.
acceptanceCriteria: Returned string contains the task title
Returned string contains the task description
Returned string contains the PROMPT.md content
Returned string contains the PRD.md content (or a summary)
Handles missing PROMPT.md gracefully (uses default instructions)

steps.details: Create the file (or add to loop-runner.ts). Import fs-extra, path, Task type.

async function readAgentFile(agentDir: string, relativePath: string, defaultContent = ''): Promise<string> { const fullPath = path.join(agentDir, relativePath); try { return await fs.readFile(fullPath, 'utf-8') } catch { return defaultContent } }

technicalNotes: Keep the DEFAULT_PROMPT constant in this file as a fallback if PROMPT.md doesn't exist
The PRD content could be very long — consider truncating to the last N characters if the AI has a context limit
